snippet.title: Barbarian — Official Trailer | Open World Survival RPG (1–10 Players)
snippet.description:
Barbarian is a multiplayer open-world survival RPG built around skill-based, soulslike-inspired combat.

Master precise dodges and parries, defeat powerful bosses, and build your base. Play solo or with friends.

Early Access launches May 26, 2026.

Developed over 5+ years by a solo developer.

❤️ Wishlist on Steam:
